<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check the initial state of level 2 to understand the starting positions
# and movement mechanics better

# First, let's see what happened when we first moved the 8-pixel green
# from the history
for entry in history:
    if hasattr(entry, 'action') and entry.action:
        frame = entry.frame
        seg = frame.segmentation
        step = frame.step
        greens = []
        for n in seg['nodes']:
            if n['color'] == 'N':
                b = n['boundary']
                rows = [p[0] for p in b]
                cols = [p[1] for p in b]
                center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
                greens.append((center, n['pixels']))
        if len(greens) == 4:
            print(f"Step {step}, action={entry.action}: greens={greens}")

# Now let's focus on moving the 8-pixel green to frame (52, 52)
# First click on it to select it
print("\n--- Moving 8-pixel green to frame (52, 52) ---")
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 55, 'col': 37}])
print(f"Clicked on (55, 37): board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")

# Now move it to (52, 52)
# From (55, 37) to (52, 52): need UP 3 and RIGHT 15
# Let's try UP UP UP RIGHT RIGHT RIGHT RIGHT RIGHT
result = action(['UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        greens[n['hash']] = center
print("After moves:", greens)
print(f"level_completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
